newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle market lightly tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle market lightly tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with no sales of slaughter steers confirmed, USDA said. Not enough slaughter heifers confirmed for a market test. Inquiry and demand generally light.

Sales confirmed on 400 slaughter heifers Friday. This weeks confirmed sales 69,300 head including 18,900 head or about 27 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink. Slaughter Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1085 lbs 66.00. Confirmed - 400 last week - 200 last year - 400
